Proof in the paper: The nanosheets consist of ultrasmall, crystalline nanodomains (marked region 1; Figure 3h) as the major constituent and amorphous nanodomains (marked region 2; Figure 3i) as the minor constituent. The crystalline nanodomains show well-resolved lattice fringes with interplanar spacings of 0.23, 0.17, and 0.33 nm corresponding to the (111), (200), and (001) planes of (NixFe1–x)2P, respectively.
